prompt: Create an original 180 second fingerstyle acoustic folk instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: steel-string guitar, mandolin, light hand percussion. Style: alternating bass picking and a clear acoustic melody. Tempo approximately 76 BPM; F major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental piece featuring a prominent acoustic guitar melody, supported by a gentle bassline and light percussion. The music evokes a peaceful and serene atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首平静而富有沉思感的器乐作品，以突出的原声吉他旋律为主，辅以柔和的贝斯线和轻快的打击乐。音乐营造出宁静祥和的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
